content.short: Fliptos is a high-speed, capital-efficient NFT marketplace and liquidity hub on the Aptos blockchain.
content.description: Fliptos is an innovative NFT marketplace and liquidity protocol built natively for the Aptos ecosystem. Designed to facilitate seamless digital asset trading, the platform offers advanced features such as real-time floor price tracking, low-latency execution, and instant sweep capabilities. By leveraging the parallel execution engine and Move programming language of Aptos, Fliptos provides creators and collectors with a highly secure, cost-effective trading environment.
